description: POST /burrows provisioning received the new per-run branch (warren/run_<id>) without a baseBranch. The fresh-clone materializer (materializeViaClone in src/workspace/materialize.ts) treated branch as an existing remote branch and ran git clone --branch warren/run_<id>, which fails because a per-run branch never exists on the remote. Regression: a seeded run against a registered project never reached Sapling (bug warren-3fa1).
resolution: materializeViaClone now branches on options.createBranch (default true): it clones the base ref (options.baseBranch ?? 'main') and then carves the run branch locally with git checkout -b warren/run_<id> — the clone-side analogue of `git worktree add -b <branch> <baseBranch>`. When createBranch=false (checking out an existing branch), it clones the requested branch directly as before. Optional baseBranch defaults to 'main' so existing callers are unaffected, but the project-provisioning path must pass the registered project's defaultBranch as baseBranch. End-to-end regression test added (fresh clone carves the per-run branch off baseBranch).
